content: The dissertation reports that Niʿmatullāhi hagiographical sources record Shah Niʿmat Allāh Valī (d. 834/1431) and Shaykh Qāsim-i Anvār (d. 837/1433) accompanying Ibn Turka and Sharaf al-Dīn on a visit to Akhlāṭī in Cairo, and portray Niʿmat Allāh as having told them to seek Akhlāṭī out; the Munshaʾāt confirm warm relations but the Cairo visit rests on the hagiography.
